headline: Western Sydney International Airport Opens to Commercial Passenger Operations
summary: Sydney's new Western Sydney International Airport officially opened to commercial passenger services, unlocking major new transport and infrastructure capacity for the surrounding region.
why: Major new hub airports generate significant capital investment, logistical capacity, and long-term commercial real estate development in surrounding metropolitan areas.

impacts.name: Australia
impacts.why: Operational opening expands aviation capacity and spurs regional economic development across Western Sydney.
